notes.title: A small update to the help system.
notes.notes:
The help system has been changed, now the circle will be narrowed over time. The first time after 20 seconds, the second time after 40 seconds and the third time after a minute.
Also improved the system of obtaining achievements, and checking for achievements at the start of the game.
